title: Equality of the configuration contexts
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string and let $c,B,e$ be natural numbers. The context encoding of $x$ with radius parameter $c$ and code-iteration parameters $B,e$ equals the context encoding of $x$ with radius $c((\operatorname{bits}( |\operatorname{bits}(|x|)|)+1)$ and iteration bound $B(|x|+1)^e$, where the radius parameter is represented by its binary expansion and the code sequence is iterated for the stated bound.
